title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust isn't just a benchmark—it's a protocol that ensures every step of navigation is verified and trustworthy.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking is essential because without measurable standards, trustworthiness remains subjective and unverifiable.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust uses real-world datasets with human-in-the-loop validation, making it far more reliable than abstract benchmarks.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking drives innovation by allowing researchers to compare methods objectively—without it, progress stalls.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Trust without measurement is just a hope. Benchmarking turns hope into progress.
